items.title: Mitchel McAllister Interview, 1960-03-19
items.q: We had a quartet. I was singing tenor. Bud was leading. Walter King was, uh, singing baritone.

ctx.x: You said a trombone was first.

Trombone was first, then the cornet, then the cornet again, and then the clarinet, and the violon. Then his, uh, Walter King, a boy from New Orleans, a Chinaman, a Chinaman. And he married his daughter. He was a violin player. What year was the trombone? What year was the trombone came in, though?
About what time? Would that be before World War I or after?
